parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch distinct="true">
  <entity name="gap_monitoringactivity">

    <attribute name="gap_monitoringactivityid" />
    <attribute name="gap_sourcetemplateversion" />
    <attribute name="gap_currentstage" />

    <filter type="and">

      <!-- Restrict to the relevant Monitoring Structure / Application -->
      <condition
        attribute="gap_monitoringstructure"
        operator="eq"
        value="@{triggerOutputs()?['body/gap_monitoringstructureid']}" />

      <filter type="or">

        <condition
          attribute="gap_sourcetemplateversion"
          operator="null" />

        <condition
          attribute="gap_sourcetemplateversion"
          operator="ne"
          valueof="mat.gap_templateversion" />

      </filter>

    </filter>

    <link-entity
      name="gap_monitoringactivitytemplate"
      from="gap_monitoringactivitytemplateid"
      to="gap_monitoringactivitytemplate"
      alias="mat"
      link-type="inner">

      <attribute name="gap_templateversion" />

    </link-entity>

  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch>
  <entity name="gap_monitoringchecklistquestiontemplate">

    <attribute name="gap_monitoringchecklistquestiontemplateid" />
    <attribute name="gap_order" />
    <attribute name="gap_name" />
    <attribute name="gap_type" />
    <attribute name="gap_choiceoptions" />

    <link-entity
      name="gap_monitoringchecklistsectiontemplate"
      from="gap_monitoringchecklistsectiontemplateid"
      to="gap_monitoringchecklistsectiontemplate"
      alias="section"
      link-type="inner">

      <attribute name="gap_monitoringchecklistsectiontemplateid" />
      <attribute name="gap_section" />
      <attribute name="gap_order" />

      <link-entity
        name="gap_monitoringchecklisttemplate"
        from="gap_monitoringchecklisttemplateid"
        to="gap_monitoringchecklisttemplate"
        alias="checklist"
        link-type="inner">

        <attribute name="gap_monitoringchecklisttemplateid" />
        <attribute name="gap_name" />

      </link-entity>

    </link-entity>

    <order attribute="gap_order" descending="false" />

  </entity>
</fetch>

<fetch>
  <entity name="gap_monitoringchecklistquestion">

    <attribute name="gap_order" />
    <attribute name="gap_name" />
    <attribute name="gap_type" />
    <attribute name="gap_choiceoptions" />

    <link-entity
      name="gap_monitoringchecklistsection"
      from="gap_monitoringchecklistsectionid"
      to="gap_monitoringchecklistsection"
      alias="section"
      link-type="inner">

      <attribute name="gap_section" />
      <attribute name="gap_order" />
      <attribute name="gap_monitoringchecklistsectionid" />

      <link-entity
        name="gap_monitoringchecklist"
        from="gap_monitoringchecklistid"
        to="gap_monitoringchecklist"
        alias="checklist"
        link-type="inner">

        <attribute name="gap_name" />

        <link-entity
          name="gap_monitoringactivity"
          from="gap_monitoringchecklist"
          to="gap_monitoringchecklistid"
          alias="activity"
          link-type="inner">

          <filter>
            <condition
              attribute="gap_monitoringactivityid"
              operator="eq"
              value="@{outputs('Get_Latest_Monitoring_Activity')?['body/gap_monitoringactivityid']}" />
          </filter>

        </link-entity>

      </link-entity>

    </link-entity>

    <order attribute="gap_order" descending="false" />

  </entity>
</fetch>
